purpose: Prevent stale composites, legacy matrices, generated convenience assets, or friendly filenames from masquerading as current visual authority.
production_rule: A character-bearing renderer input is authoritative only when its mounted source bytes hash to the current approved expected_sha256 for that Character ID. Asset names, tags, prompts, composites, previews, and generated redraws are not authority.
derived_asset_rule: A generated or composite asset may never become PRIMARY_IDENTITY_AUTHORITY by filename/tag. Promotion requires an explicit Commissioner-approved source supersession recorded in canon and a new approved SHA-256.
